purpose: development diagnostic for a cross-task progress controller combined with vertical task knowledge
analysis_scope: Development only. Cases were selected after inspecting T1 and cannot support a held-out claim.
task_selection_reason: melt:v025 and freeze:v026 produced different Horizontal-only and Vertical-only outcomes in T1
development_gate: Proceed to a new held-out task family only if t2_full is more successful than both single-layer conditions and the controller prevents repeated-action budget exhaustion.
failure_rule: If t2_full does not beat both single-layer conditions on these development cases, this controller version does not establish the T-shaped combination hypothesis.
